memoryBuilder.verseText: I am with you always, right to the very end.

sequence.prompt: What happened on the hill? Put it in order.

items.label: Jesus kept showing His friends He was alive
Jesus said: 'Go and tell everybody about Me'
Jesus was lifted up into a bright cloud
Two angels said He will come back

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: It carried Jesus home to His throne
In heaven and on earth, it belongs to Jesus

application.question: Jesus is King everywhere, and He is with you. Where do you most need to remember that?
application.followUp: Jesus went up to rule, not to go away. He has all power in heaven and on earth, and He is praying for you right now. Jesus is with us.
